answer: A payout is split so that 39% arrives at settlement and the rest over 6 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The river schedule is applied in summit and jetty publishes each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4422 identities would post 1822 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
